D1_hc1_amendment.decision: APPROVED - amend H-C1 from set equality to subset-with-zero-missing

D2_retain_all_453.explicit_statement: No independent evidence demonstrated technical invalidity for any soft-flagged sample. Of the 29 flagged samples, 26 had NO independent technical evidence of invalidity, and the remaining 3 carried only further statistical flags (extreme PCA score, or a degradation contrast deviating from the unflagged median) rather than a demonstrated technical fault. The sole direct technical measure available on this matrix - the AFFX 3'/5' degradation contrast - did NOT discriminate flagged from unflagged arrays (ACTB median 0.792 vs 0.772; GAPDH 0.259 vs 0.188).

D3_observations_not_justifications.decision: APPROVED - record as QC OBSERVATIONS, explicitly NOT exclusion justifications

observations.subject: batch05 flag-rate association
observations.finding: Soft-flag rate varies by ComBat processing batch: batch05 20.4% (10/49), batch03 7.8%, batch02/09/10 0.0%. chi2=23.2, df=8, p=0.003, Cramer's V=0.226.
observations.interpretation: Batch-ASSOCIATED but not batch-DETERMINED. Markedly weaker than the near-deterministic batch patterning found for molecular-assay missingness in Phase 6D.
observations.action_taken: none - no sample excluded, no batch correction applied

observations.subject: GSM972311 clustering singleton
observations.finding: Hierarchical clustering 2-cluster cut splits 452/1, isolating GSM972311. Its sum(1-rho)=57.72 is the cohort maximum and ~1.8x the Tukey fence of 32.098.
observations.interpretation: Correlation-distant WITHOUT being distributionally or degradation-abnormal: per-array median 4.8096 and IQR 2.8450 both lie inside their fences, PCA z-scores are unremarkable (PC1 -0.48, PC2 -2.19), and its degradation contrast shows no deviation.
